correctness.rationale: The system is strongly cooperative for delta>0, strictly sublinear because u/(m+u)-hu decreases strictly for u>0 when m>=1/h, and bounded by a logistic scalar comparison. Its zero Jacobian L has det=delta(e-s)-es and Perron sign positive below delta_c (or always if e<=s). Strictly ordered scalar multiples yield uniqueness and attraction of the one positive equilibrium via monotone comparison. Negative Perron root gives exponential decay with positive left eigenvector. At delta_c weighted mass a*u+v decreases at least s*v^2; integrability and uniform continuity force v->0 and u->0, so the center-stable decomposition X=z(a,1)+w(1,-a) yields w/z->0 and zprime=-k z^2+o(z^2), k=[s+a^3(h-1/m)]/(1+a^2)>0; hence the universal physical-time t^-1 profile. Lyapunov–Schmidt projection gives alpha=(1-a)^2/(1+a^2) and branch slope alpha/k. Boundary m=1/h remains quadratic via the v component.
residual_risks: Finite verification alone does not establish universal quantifiers; correctness rests on the fully reconstructed proof.
